35.
Exemptions,  restrictions  or  derogations  to  the
provisions  of  this  Act  shall  not  be  allowed  except  where
such  an  exemption,  restriction  or  derogation  is  prescribed
by regulations and respects the essence of the fundamental
rights  and  freedoms  and  constitutes  a  necessary  and
proportionate measure in a democratic society for–

(a)
the protection of national security, defense, public
safety,  public  health,  economic  and  financial
systems stability of Republic of Sri Lanka;
